summary: A DFM whose Engine-generated input or ratio basis is cached at a different period now regenerates it at the method's own period during save and downstream refresh instead of failing with an incompatible origin period length.
details: A quarterly DFM fed by a dataset cached annually no longer blocks the downstream refresh after an upstream save.
The regenerated cache is written beside the existing one; the dataset's sidecar and primary cache are left as they were.
DFM and Result Selection now share one resolver for reading a precedent at the method's period.
